title: AlchemyTales V1.0.0 Dev Log
author: Ok-Construction6990
selftext:
AlchemyTales V1.0.0 is here with a **massive batch of combat content**! This update rebuilds the core loop around "Secret Realm battles" — from realm exploration and crafting to item collection, a complete combat ecosystem is now in place. Here is what's new.

# Update Overview

* **Secret Realm Exploration**: Once you reach Foundation Establishment, step into the Scripture Trial Grounds and descend floor by floor as the difficulty climbs.
* **Crafting System**: New Enchanting Altar / Formation Altar / Talisman Altar — forge your own combat gear by hand.
* **Item System**: New weapons, armor, formations, and talismans — each with its own distinct effect.
* **Progression & Supply**: Clear floors for Spirit Stones and Spirit Artifacts, then pick your own stat buffs and open the shop.

# Secret Realm Exploration

After breaking through to **Foundation Establishment**, you may enter the **Scripture Trial Grounds** and officially begin your Secret Realm battles.

* **Descend deeper, face rising danger**: The realm is made of multiple floors. The deeper you clear, the fiercer the enemies and their mechanics become. Every step down is a true test of your cultivation.
* **Rich spoils of battle**: Every fight in the trials can yield rewards such as **Spirit Stones** and **Spirit Artifacts**. The deeper you go, the rarer the gifts.
* **Clear a floor, grow stronger**: After clearing each floor, choose a **stat-boosting buff** to shape your combat style, and the **shop** opens — stock up on **Spirit Artifacts, Formations, Talismans, and Pill Recipes** to prepare for the next descent.

# Crafting System

Raw power is not enough — you must also master the art of "refining." This update adds three crafting stations so your gear truly serves you.

* **Enchanting Altar**: Enchant your **Pills** and **Spirit Artifacts** to add elemental bonus damage, squeezing more power out of what you already carry into battle.
* **Formation Altar**: After learning a **Formation Manual**, forge **Formations** at the Enchanting Altar. Deploy them in the Secret Realm to reshape the battlefield and turn the tide.
* **Talisman Altar**: After learning a **Talisman Manual**, craft **Talismans** at the Enchanting Altar. Carry them into the realm and hurl them at the crucial moment to unleash elemental techniques.

# Items

The depth of combat comes from every well-suited implement in your hand. This update adds a rich variety of items — **weapons, armor, formations, and talismans** — each with its **own unique effect**:

* **Weapons**: Instruments of offense that define your damage style and combat tempo.
* **Armor**: The foundation of defense, shielding you from the realm's lethal threats.
* **Formations**: The eyes of the battlefield — deploy them to alter terrain and the tide of war.
* **Talismans**: The edge of the elements — flung in one breath to become an area of certain death.

Combined with the crafting system, build a combat style that is truly your own.
